CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), presentation mapping and origin/status are all explicitly given for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to identified content/presentation.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit coordinate lists identify colored content (red/blue) for named records.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are presented separately from the listed content coordinates, distinguishing content from its status/source.

O.rationale: The text specifies how the grid is organized and presents content as coordinate sets for named records.
